about.studioText: Sophia Foundry is a small game studio. Solo for now, growing soon. We make games. When the tools we need don't exist, we build them.
about.missionText: We're here to make memorable games. We release the tools we built to make them.
about.coherenceDesc: Our tools come from the games we make. The games shape the tools, and the tools shape the games.
about.craftDesc: We're the first users. The community is who we build for.
about.accessDesc: Tools for everyone. The best tools should not be locked behind the biggest budgets.
